items.question: Which trades feed should the raw-book arm of a feed-granularity test use, when the question is whether the 100 ms book feed mis-measures a pull/post accounting?

options.label: (a)
options.text: raw trades for the raw arm, plus a diagnostic arm on raw book with 100 ms trades

options.label: (b)
options.text: 100 ms trades only for the raw arm

options.label: (c)
options.text: raw trades only, no diagnostic arm

items.rationale: Records the most and separates book granularity from trade-timing misalignment, which pushes the accounting the same way as the hypothesis.

items.question: Episode pairing rule for the primary read when the raw arm may fragment episodes the 100 ms arm sees whole

options.label: (a)
options.text: aligned pairs only (same side, level, generation; open and close within 500 ms)

options.label: (b)
options.text: aligned pairs primary, plus a concatenation secondary and a same-instant secondary, all reported

items.rationale: Aligned pairs are the only pairs with equal spans; the two secondaries show what fragmentation does to the answer.

items.question: Thresholds of a pre-registered read rule comparing per-episode pullFrac between two feeds

options.label: (a)
options.text: p < 0.01; material = flips >= 5 % of pairs or median |delta| >= 0.05; balance band +-0.10; minimum 200 pairs

options.label: (c)
options.text: no pre-registered thresholds; judge after the data

items.rationale: Pre-registered before any run data was read; 200 pairs give a sign test that detects a 60/40 split at p about 0.005.

items.question: Where should a long authenticated read-only market-data probe run, when the dev machine shuts down nightly and the key ruling says dev machine only?

options.label: (a)
options.text: a temporary cloud instance for 24 h, key in a mode-600 env file, after the key ruling's text is updated

options.label: (b)
options.text: the dev machine, 6 h or less, ending before the nightly shutdown

options.label: (c)
options.text: several dev-machine runs on separate days

items.rationale: Trader direction relayed 2026-10-05. Records the most pairs and covers every session; the ruling text must be updated before the key moves.

items.question: Run length for a feed-comparison probe whose minimum count is reachable in a few hours

options.label: (b)
options.text: stop once the 200-pair minimum is met

items.rationale: Records the most and covers all three sessions; still ends before the dependent read. Cost: the temporary instance lives about 13 h longer.
